description: This file manages resource permissions, including role-based access control (RBAC) and policy-based access control (PBAC) checks, for various resources within a system. It includes functions to get permissions for resources, specific actions, and routing forms, utilizing external repositories and services.

methods.name: checkRoleAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user role has access based on a role mapping and optional condition.

methods.name: getResourcePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a resource, considering PBAC feature flag and fallback roles.

methods.name: getSpecificPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for specific actions on a resource, considering PBAC feature flag and fallback roles.

methods.name: getRoutingFormPermissions
methods.description: Determines permissions for routing forms based on user membership and parent organization admin status.
